description:
# Telink SWS

Read and program Telink TLSR825x devices using Flipper Zero's GPIO pins
and the single-wire SWire debug protocol.

## Features

- Live contact monitoring with on-screen status, LED and sound feedback.
- Optional automatic CPU halt when a target is detected.
- Chip identification, GPIO diagnostics, and core and analog register access.
- Flash dumps to the microSD card with repeated reads, CRC32 reporting,
  and contact-loss recovery.
- Flash erase and programming with verification, write-protection checks,
  and protection for factory MAC and calibration sectors.

## Hardware and operation

Connect the target's SWS pad to Flipper C0, C1, or C3 and connect a common
ground. Flipper's 3V3 output can power a compatible target.

Keep the app open and use the Flipper USB serial CLI to perform operations.
Enter **sws help** for commands. The device screen shows contact status;
press OK to toggle automatic CPU halt and Back to exit.

[Wiring and command documentation](https://github.com/ngxson/flipper-telink)
